description: Estimate UK Statutory Maternity Pay over the 39 weeks under gov.uk rules: 90% of average weekly earnings for 6 weeks, then the lower of the statutory flat rate or 90%. Uses the 2026-27 gov.uk flat rate of £194.32 a week, which changes each April. Estimate only, not advice.

annualSalary.description: Annual salary before tax (GBP), converted at /52.
